name: Basic Playback
author: Vestra Player
punchline: Bottom control bar, open files and links, seek and speed
description:
The control bar at the bottom of the main window (seek bar, play buttons, volume); open a file, open a link, reopen the last file; several seek steps, keyframe seeks, jump to a time, fixed and custom speeds; an A-B loop that repeats a range a chosen number of times; time or thumbnail on seek bar hover; no screen saver while playing.
Playback… (Alt+4) in the right-click menu opens its panel beside the video: speed, A-B Loop, jump, frame and keyframe steps, seek steps.
